about: Launch sites where GCAT's launch table gives a site that the launching state's own report contradicts. Each fix names the site GCAT gives, so a fix goes quiet once GCAT corrects the row or changes it to something else (the build lists those as stale). Reviewed by hand; add one only with a published report that names the site.

source.title: China launches Zhuzhou Space Interstellar PIESAT-2 13-16 satellites

fixes.check: Both closure areas (NOTAMs A4456/26 and A4457/26) lie on one bearing from Taiyuan, 188 deg at 330 and 518 NM, the launch azimuth of a 97.5 deg orbit from Taiyuan (about 190 deg); from Jiuquan they lie at 129 and 140 deg.

source.title: Gravity-1 succeeds in maiden flight from the sea

fixes.check: CGTN: launched from the waters surrounding Haiyang, Shandong (the Yellow Sea). The charted launch point lies off Haiyang, 104 NM from GCAT's Huang Hai point and 1,039 NM from Yangjiang, and the launch's closure areas run south-east from it.
